## Phase 1 — the framework table (the S168 law, executed in this container)

The S168 restore law names `tools/android-34.jar` (resources.arsc 16,424,688 bytes) — the tools/ tree is wiped in fresh containers. **Census of 31 dl.google.com URLs** (all live API-34 platform zips: ext7_r01/r02/r03, ext8_r01, ext10/ext11/ext12_r01, cross-checked against repository2-1/2/3.xml): **EVERY official revision ships the IDENTICAL 16,390,624-byte resources.arsc.** The S168 16,424,688-byte jar is NOT any public Google API-34 platform (likely a community extended-android.jar or an android-35 mislabel). PROVENANCE QUESTION for the main coder: where did `tools/android-34.jar` come from? Until answered, this wave pins the public `platform-34-ext7_r03.zip` table (16,390,624 bytes, installed at `miniandroid/framework_res/resources.arsc`, FWRES line confirms types=22).

dooz is table-revision-INSENSITIVE (identical face under both tables); with the main coder's own table the bouncy/unote records stay authoritative.

## Phase 2 — the dooz flat-white ROOT-CAUSE chain (five experiments, one law)

1. **Trace-diff** (pristine vs merged dooz runs, normalized token sequences, 108 hunks — evidence/w21/dooz_seqdiff/): the FIRST behavioral fork was the F696 onActivityCreated fan-out window — a RED HERRING (see #2/#3). The REAL fork = **hunk #123**: merged:3617 `[F720-NEVERNULL] Lm7;.j = materialized Lkc; obj#9928` → merged:3618 `Lkc;.p pc=4` NPE `invoke-interface Lqp1;.getValue on a null object reference` vs pristine:3610 `[F274-CTORGATE] Lm7;.j initializer type Lkc; has no ()V ctor -> honest null` → `Lm7;.b` returns FALSE on its OWN null-guard → layout completes (1468 ops, REAL_APP_CONTENT).
2. **A/B #1** (F696 fragment-advancement deferred): dooz still flat — hypothesis refuted.
3. **A/B #2** (F696 FULL disable): dooz still flat, BYTE-IDENTICAL — **F696 exonerated** (and re-armed: NC needs it).
4. **A/B #3** (entire `bridge_to_api_w19` stack disabled, F-C4-664..691): dooz still flat — **the W19 stack exonerated** (the F668-registry observer hypothesis refuted too).
5. **androguard decode** (evidence/w21/dooz_lex_analysis.txt, 184KB): `Lel0;` = androidx.compose.ui.node.LayoutNode; **`.I()Z` ≡ `J.p.w`** — a plain "is placed" boolean (3 instructions, no comparisons). TRUE only from the attach path (root) and `Lbt0;.q0()` (the place pass); the merged run shows **zero q0 executions** → all content nodes keep `w=false` → `Lug0;.h1` (InnerNodeCoordinator.draw) child-gate skips every node → ops=0 → DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_ONLY. The NPE cascade: `Lkc;.p` NPE → `Lnt1;.e`/`Lto1;.d`x11 → `Lbt0;.y0`x11 → `Lel0;.Y`x11 → `Lt4;.onMeasure` unwind → measure aborts mid-tree → **the place pass never runs**. Also identified: `Lpo0;` = LifecycleDispatcher$DispatcherActivityCallback, `Lu91;` = ProcessLifecycleOwner$ActivityLifecycleCallbacks (benign).
6. **Root cause**: F-C4-720 (W20) materialized `Lm7;.j` as a RAW allocation of `Lkc;` — an object whose ctor NEVER RAN (a ZOMBIE): its Compose State fields stay null and the first getter NPEs. The W20 rationale ("ART: field never null after ctor") held only for SETTER-shaped consumers (NC setEndIconOnClickListener); a GETTER-shaped consumer (dooz Lkc;.p) reads the zombie's null internals.

## Phase 3 — the F722 real-ctor cascade (attempted, REFUTED, excised — the honest record)

F-C4-722 replaced the raw allocation with a REAL-construction cascade: ()V ctor first, then arg-ful ctors with synthesizable args (enclosing receiver / 0-false primitives / "" String) + post-construction interface-field validation. Result: **dooz still flat** — Kotlin/Compose type ERASURE hides the interface State fields behind `Ljava/lang/Object;` declarations (`Lkc;` fields = `a:I`, `b/c/d:Ljava/lang/Object;` — the interface predicate is a no-op); the device-faithful ctor `<init>(Ljava/lang/Object;Ljava/lang/Object;Ljava/lang/Object;I)V` is unsynthesizable; the synthesized `(I)V` ctor accepts but leaves b/c/d null (same zombie, one level deeper). **NC regressed** — failed ctor attempts left partial-execution side effects on the heap (uncaught 6→20, the IconHelper root lost, face drift 33fd925f→253fa32b); try_recursive_invoke failures do not roll back the ctor's partial writes. F722/F722v fully excised from the final tree (grep REALCTOR = 0).

## Phase 4 — THE LANDING: F-C4-720 restored verbatim behind MINIANDROID_F720_LAW (DEFAULT-OFF)

The S194 face-sensitivity precedent applied verbatim (F654/F692 idiom): `static thread_local const bool f720_law_on = std::getenv("MINIANDROID_F720_LAW") != nullptr;` in front of the EXACT W20 F720 body (no semantic edits). OFF = the F274 honest-null gate (the app's OWN null-guards engage — the pristine-S206 behavior). The full A/B on the FINAL binary `5e9307150c09056f`:

| Mode | dooz | bouncy | unote | NC uncaught | NC root | NC probes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DEFAULT (F720 OFF) | **`a0fae9072313e2d1`** — the S206 golden RESTORED byte-exact | `ac44245d2be515fd` | `2a6571e8d56ef005` | 20 (grep-ci) | endLayout NPE (the W19-era shallower root) | F720 0 |
| MINIANDROID_F720_LAW=1 | — | — | — | **6 (1 in-flight, the exact W20 record)** | **IconHelper CheckableImageButton NPE (the W20 root)** | **7x F720-NEVERNULL, 2x F696-CREATED-WINDOW, 7/7 W20-GET (map=488)** |

**CB — the F720-off bonus (4th face-sensitive app, root-caused in evidence/w21/W21_CB_FACE_AB.md)**: with F720 ON, CB's extra AndroidComposeView.onMeasure pass hits the F-NEW-496 no-write-back fallback → compose collapse → the flat `b5a7a35d` face. With F720 OFF (the landed default): **CB crosses to REAL_APP_CONTENT — 11,156 app-owned pixels, face `f5ad0193b8a24933`** — stable across 6 runs, 2 harnesses, cold/warm stores. The 4APP battery's first REAL_APP_CONTENT face. TB (`43bfdac6023cba66`) and TSK (`e09e3cc1825c1e32`, the real dark-theme `#191C1E` via the framework table) byte-stable both modes.
